hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // \"\"" | { read -r f; case "$f" in *"/react-site/src/data/"*) n=$(basename "$f" .js | sed "s/^r0*//"); b=$(echo "$f" | sed -n "s#.*/src/data/\(book[0-9]*\)/.*#\1#p"); cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/react-site" && node scripts/validate-reading.mjs "$b/$(basename "$f")" "$n" 2>&1 | grep -E "^(FAIL|ERROR)" | head -10;; *"/react-site/src/"*|*"/react-site/scripts/"*) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/react-site" && npm run build --silent 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|failed" | head -20;; esac; } 2>/dev/null; exit 0

s=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" status --porcelain | head -20); if [ -n "$s" ]; then n=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d " "); jq -cn --arg s "$s" --arg n "$n" "{systemMessage: (\"Uncommitted: \" + \$n + \" file(s). Commit if the build is green, and refresh NEXT.md.\\n\" + \$s)}"; fi; exit 0
